title: Road, sidewalk and trail closure alerts update
body:
Road, sidewalk and trail closure alerts update
Back to News Search
Subscribe
By
City of Waterloo
-
Nov 09, 2026
Road closures
Trail and sidewalk closures
Going forward, road closure subscribers will once again receive an email when a new road closure is identified.
This means you’ll get closure information sooner, as it becomes available. You can also
choose which updates you’d like to receive:
road closures, trail and sidewalk closures, or both.
Visit the
Check road, sidewalk and trail closures page
to view a map of closures and get the latest information.
Thank you for your patience through these changes, and for continuing to subscribe to City of Waterloo closure updates.
